principle: Resolve by verified customer decision job, not visual adjectives, industry labels, asset convenience, or company identity.

rows.discriminator: BW-F05 when the category is already accepted and option/service self-selection is the blocker; BW-F08 when category understanding/self-placement must happen before option choice.
rows.human_review_trigger: verified truth cannot establish category readiness or both jobs are genuinely co-dominant

rows.discriminator: BW-F05 when routing to the right option is first; BW-F02 when suitability, safety, risk or wrong-choice reassurance must be resolved first.
rows.human_review_trigger: diagnostic routing and safety reassurance are inseparable before any useful next event

rows.discriminator: BW-F07 only when ongoing local/community relationship materially changes choice; BW-F04 when human technique, maker/provenance or craft is the trust mechanism and locality is incidental.
rows.human_review_trigger: locality exists in brand language but decision relevance is not evidenced

rows.discriminator: BW-F07 when relationship/place is the gating trust job; BW-F05 when service or option routing is the gating decision job.
rows.human_review_trigger: a local multi-service business has co-dominant relationship and routing barriers

rows.discriminator: BW-F01 when imagined sensory experience, ritual or atmosphere itself creates desire; BW-F04 when human/material provenance or technique is indispensable to trust/meaning.
rows.human_review_trigger: sensory experience and provenance are equally central and cannot be subordinated

rows.discriminator: BW-F01 when sensory state/lifestyle fit leads; BW-F03 when aspirational status, desired self-image or specialist authority leads into proof and commitment.
rows.human_review_trigger: sensory worldview and premium authority are genuinely co-dominant

rows.discriminator: BW-F01 when the customer understands the category and desire depends on sensory imagination; BW-F08 when category comprehension/self-placement precedes desire or commitment.
rows.human_review_trigger: category readiness is uncertain and the same calm/recognition visual grammar could hide the distinction

rows.discriminator: BW-F03 when aspirational/editorial authority is the first persuasive job; BW-F04 when maker, practitioner, technique or provenance authority must lead.
rows.human_review_trigger: specialist prestige and practitioner/maker provenance are inseparable in the verified decision state

rows.discriminator: BW-F03 when authority/desire leads and mechanism proof supports commitment; BW-F06 when method/process credibility is the gating question from the outset.
rows.human_review_trigger: specialist authority and mechanism efficacy are co-equal before persuasive progress
rows.phase_c_reference: kakimoto/pilates K vs deferred F06 wave

rows.discriminator: Use the same F01/F03 rule symmetrically; luxury styling, large type, natural palette or image mood never resolve the collision.
rows.human_review_trigger: decision-state evidence remains insufficient after verified truth review

hard_failure_conditions: family selected from industry name alone
family changed because assets/rights/evidence are difficult
unresolved genuine co-dominance silently forced to a winner
visual similarity is used as evidence that two companies share a Family
